verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an embeddable fiat-to-crypto on-ramp widget, which can run in a modal or in-app web view, plus a Web SDK with card, Apple Pay and Google Pay frames. Its enterprise API also accepts bank transfers and converts incoming fiat into stablecoins. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that stablecoins are buyable inside the embedded widget/SDK flow (stablecoin wording appears only on the enterprise page), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a fiat-to-stablecoin onramp — a documented widget or API where end users buy stablecoins with cards or bank transfers inside my product

citations.quote: With the MoonPay fiat-to-crypto On-Ramp, users can purchase cryptocurrencies directly from your website or web3 application.
there are several options to integrate MoonPay widget. For example, in a modal overlaid on top of your web app, or in an in-app web view.
accept bank transfers through local payment rails and SWIFT, and automatically convert incoming fiat into stablecoins through one API platform.
The frame renders a single payment button (card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay) matching the payment method in the quote, and runs the buy pipeline on tap.
Use a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay to buy crypto fast. We also accept bank transfers and wires.
